propositions: The lifespan drain waits only on queue.join() but reconcile_once runs review_and_vote inline outside the queue, so a reconciler review in flight is cancelled within ~10s when the queue empties, not protected by the full shutdown_drain_seconds budget.
Any container stop signal (manual compose restart, host reboot, rollback) kills an in-flight reconciler review with no drain, because the existing drain logic does not await reconciler completion.
The reconcile loop must not start new reviews once shutdown begins, else the drain window could extend indefinitely.
The shutdown drain must share a single shutdown_drain_seconds budget across both the webhook queue and the reconciler in-flight work, bounded by the existing stop_grace_period.
The stop path must record remaining candidates in held_back to preserve the cursor low-water-mark invariant and prevent silent candidate loss.
The stop flag must clear at the end of shutdown, not at startup, so it does not outlive a lifespan restart and poison subsequent reconcile_once runs.
